description: Implementation of ProductRelationshipService managing product relationship entities, including CRUD operations and group management, using Spring Framework and DAO layer.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing product relationships, providing methods for CRUD operations, group management, and retrieval by type or group.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductRelationship or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product relationship group for a specific store with a specified name.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all product relationships belonging to a specific group in a store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Sets all relationships in a group to inactive.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Sets all relationships in a group to active.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific ProductRelationship after retrieving it by ID to avoid detached entity exception.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, product, type, and language as applicable.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store and group name, optionally with language filtering.
